name: MCMC-based 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that reformulates 3D Gaussian Splatting training as a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) process to allow exploration without heuristics, improving reconstruction quality and robustness to initialization.
summary: MCMC-based 3D Gaussian Splatting reformulates training as a stochastic Markov Chain Monte Carlo process, replacing heuristic densification with noise-driven exploration to ensure robustness against initialization and local minima.
